=== a copy of a connected project
exit 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
onboard-project: the notes in <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy/.agent-memory aren't this folder's (<TMP>/home/workspace/alpha/.git): it looks like a copy of another project, and connecting it would take over that project's notes. To connect it as a project of its own, remove the copied notes (the other project keeps its own), then run this again:
  rm -rf <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy/.agent-memory <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy/.git/worktrees/-agent-memory; git -C <TMP>/home/workspace/alpha-copy branch -D agent-memory
